jobs.title: Senior Hydrogeologist
jobs.description:
About Us

At EA, you’ll find yourself surrounded by dynamic professionals that embrace collaboration and curiosity to foster innovation and problem-solving. This culture forms the essence of our value proposition to apply high-quality, objective, and interdisciplinary services to complex environmental challenges. With a strong foundation in servant leadership and community service, EA employees are encouraged to pursue personal and professional passions. As a team, we empower each other to share ideas, believe in our common purpose, and value differing perspectives.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Hydrogeologist with a strong background in hydrogeologic modeling to join our team in Sacramento, CA. This role will focus on providing expert hydrogeologic modeling, well and pump test design, and data interpretation for CERCLA cleanup sites associated with former hard rock mines. The ideal candidate will have significant technical experience and be available to manage related projects as needed.

Responsibilities

Hydrogeologic Modeling: Provide advanced modeling to support cleanup efforts at former hard rock mine sites under CERCLA regulations.
Well and Pump Test Design: Design well and pump tests to support hydrogeological investigations and site remediation.
Data Interpretation: Analyze and interpret hydrogeologic data to guide decision-making and remediation strategies for CERCLA sites.
Project Management: Manage hydrogeology-related projects, ensuring compliance with timelines, budgets, and regulatory requirements.
Proposal Support: Assist with the development of contract and project proposals to secure new work opportunities.
EPA Experience: Leverage your experience working on EPA projects to navigate regulatory requirements and ensure successful project execution.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 10 years of hydrogeologic experience, with a focus on CERCLA cleanup sites and former hard rock mines.
Proven experience in hydrogeologic modeling, well and pump test design, and data interpretation.
Extensive experience working on EPA projects and understanding environmental regulations.
Bachelor’s degree in Hydrogeology, Geology, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred but not required
California Licensed Hydrogeologist (CHG) or California Professional Geologist (PG) with the ability to obtain the CHG.

Note: This position requires specific driving duties. You must be able to pass a motor vehicle records check required by our insurer.

Drug Screen Statement

Offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a drug screen.

Pay Range

$150,000—$170,000 USD

The EA pay range for this position is intended as a general guideline and does not guarantee specific compensation or salary. Factors considered when making an offer include job responsibilities, education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, internal equity, alignment with market data, and compliance with federal and state laws.

Why Join EA?

At EA, our core values are openness, balance, and challenge and we strive to improve the quality of the environment in which we live, one project at a time. Our professional, team-centric culture promotes collaboration and flexibility and allows employees to guide their own career development path. To that end, we provide training and coaching to support ongoing development for our project managers and consulting engineers.

What We Provide

EA prides itself on servant leadership, career development for staff in all areas, and maintaining work-life balance including flexible schedules. We have a tremendous base of positive client relationships that has resulted in a stable backlog of projects and opportunities for growth. We offer paid volunteer time, tuition reimbursement, knowledge sharing, industry advancement, professional associations, and industry conferences. EA is proud to offer a fantastic benefits package that includes the following:

401k with Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
Competitive Salary
Low deductible health coverage for you and your family through Medical, Dental and Vision plans
Generous paid-time-off policy
Paid volunteer time
Tuition reimbursement
Professional Development
Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
Employee wellness program

Accommodation Information

If you are interested in applying for employment with EA and require special assistance or accommodation during any part of the pre-employment process, please contact the EA Talent Acquisition Office at recruitment@eaest.com. For TTY users, dial 711.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

EA is dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.

Recruiting Agency Disclaimer

Recruiting agencies should not contact EA Engineering, Science and Technology, Inc., PBC directly with unsolicited resumes. Any unsolicited resumes submitted by a recruiting agency to EA via this website or email will be deemed the sole property of EA, and EA will not be responsible for any fee associated with such unsolicited resume.

new_jobs.title: Senior Advanced Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Unissant, Inc.
delivers innovative capabilities to the agencies that keep our nation healthy and safe. We apply our domain expertise, data acumen, and technology know-how to achieve breakthrough results for our clients. Working collaboratively, we advance missions and careers through a focus on honesty, integrity, and dependability. We continuously look for talent, excited to join that effort. To learn more about our exciting organization, please visit us at www.unissant.com.

We are seeking a Senior Advanced Data Analyst
to join our team and support our client. The ideal candidate will have extensive investigative experience and advanced analytics expertise, applying predictive analytics, geospatial analysis, and network analysis to large, complex datasets in support of HSI's National Targeting Center–Investigations (NTC-I) and Homeland Security Task Forces (HSTFs).

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Apply predictive and advanced analytics to reveal trafficking and smuggling trends, cross-border routes, and high-risk facilitators.
Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and visualization tools that support intelligence-led targeting operations and leadership decision-making.
Conduct geospatial analysis, network/link analysis, and other advanced analytic techniques across trade, travel, financial, communications, and supply-chain data.
Transform complex, multi-source datasets into actionable intelligence products aligned with NTC-I and HSTF priorities.
Support lead generation and targeting initiatives by integrating data from multiple systems and producing high-quality analytic outputs.
Collaborate with HSI Data SMEs, Senior Data Visualization Developers, Program Manager, and law-enforcement partners to ensure analytic products are operationally relevant and timely.

Work Experience And Job Skills

Minimum 5–8 years of experience in advanced data analytics, data science, or quantitative analysis, preferably in a law-enforcement, intelligence, or national security environment.
Hands-on experience with BI tools and data visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) for building operational dashboards.
Strong background in statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and anomaly detection techniques.
Experience conducting geospatial and network/link analysis using tools such as GIS platforms or graph/network analysis software.
Proficiency in querying and manipulating large datasets from multiple data sources; familiarity with SQL or similar query languages preferred.
Demonstrated ability to translate analytic findings into clear, concise written products and briefings that drive operational decisions.

Education

Bachelor's Degree is required. Preferred field of study in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field of study.
MBA/Master's Degree in a relevant field of study (e.g., Data Analytics, Public Policy with quantitative focus, Intelligence) preferred.

Certificates, Licenses and Registrations

Professional certifications in data analytics, data science, or BI/visualization tools are preferred.

Communication Skills

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex quantitative findings to leadership and to frontline investigative teams.
Ability to write clear and concise analytic narratives and visual explanations in a highly confidential environment.

Clearance Requirements

Ability to obtain and maintain a clearance is required.

Travel

Occasional travel may be required to support client meetings, training, or coordination with field offices.

Environmental Requirements

Mainly a routine office environment.
May be required to lift up to ten (10) pounds.
Flexible in working extended hours.

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team at Patrick Space Force Base, Florida. This position offers an exciting opportunity to support the Space Training and Readiness Command (STARCOM) by providing data analysis, reporting, and visualizations to improve operational effectiveness, and support mission success.

The Data Analyst will collect, analyze, and interpret data from multiple enterprise systems to develop workforce analysis, and support enterprise decisions making. The successful candidate will develop reports, dashboards, and data visualizations that provide meaningful insights to government stakeholders. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

The Data Analyst will

Develop and continuously enhance STARCOM's workforce analytics capabilities, providing timely, accurate, and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
Analyze workforce, operational, and organizational data to identify trends, measure performance, and support planning efforts
Develop, maintain, and enhance executive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using data from multiple enterprise systems
Design and implement automated reporting solutions, databases, and analytics tools to improve efficiency and data accessibility
Identify workforce trends, hiring metrics, readiness indicators, and organizational performance measures to inform leadership decisions
Collaborate with government stakeholders to gather requirements and develop reporting and analytical solutions
Respond to leadership and stakeholder requests by preparing timely, accurate reports, dashboards, and analytical products
Validate, integrate, cleanse, and standardize data from multiple sources to ensure data quality and consistency
Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes and recommend enhancements that increase efficiency
Prepare reports, presentations, and data visualizations that communicate analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Develop predictive models and trend analyses to support workforce planning, forecasting, and data-driven decision-making

Skills And Experience

The Data Analyst must have

Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) security clearance
5+ years of experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD) organizations in data analytics, business intelligence, workforce analytics, or a related field
Demonstrated experience collecting, integrating, cleansing, validating, and analyzing large datasets from multiple enterprise systems
Experience developing executive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Microsoft Power BI, Power Apps, Excel, or similar business intelligence tools
Experience analyzing business processes, workforce data, and operational metrics to deliver actionable insights and recommendations
Experience collaborating with stakeholders to gather business requirements and develop data-driven analytical solutions
Experience implementing predictive analytics, forecasting models, and trend analysis to support strategic planning and organizational decision-making
Strong understanding of data quality management, governance, and data validation best practices
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment

Education and Certifications

The Data Analyst must meet the following

Required

Bachelor of Art (BA) or Bachelor of Science (BS)
Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of education

Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
401(k)
PTO
Paid Paternal leave
Tuition reimbursement
Paid federal holidays

Security Clearance

Must be a U.S. Citizen. A high-level Department of Defense active security clearance is/may be required. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to government information.

Physical Requirements

Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time and typing and reading from a computer screen. The candidate must have enough mobility, including bending, reaching, and kneeling, to complete daily duties in a prompt and efficient manner, and that may include lifting up to thirty pounds, as necessary.

Company Summary

Headquartered in Hawaii, Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC, is an SBA-Certified NHO-owned 8(a) Small Business specializing in global information technology solutions. We deliver professional services in IT Design & Installation, Cybersecurity Engineering & Support, Application Integration & Development, Software & Hardware Engineering, Network & Systems Management, Information Systems Security, and Business Management Services.

Leveraging over 30 years of providing IT services to the federal & commercial market with projects found around the world, our team has innovative expertise in the development of a wide range of technological solutions. Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

Our service commitment is simple - "Quality IT Solutions... On Time & On Budget."

new_jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

KSA Integration
is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) that provides business and management solutions through two core portfolios: (1) Warrior Readiness, and (2) Warrior Care. We are a rapidly growing government contractor that has built a reputation for focused customer service, on-time performance, and continuous improvement. To demonstrate this, KSA has been awarded the Inc. Best Workplaces, a prestigious list of businesses recognized for the value placed on company culture, standout worker benefits, and the prioritization of employee well-being, every year from 2019 to 2025. KSA also earned recognition on the Best for Vets List by Military Times from 2019 to 2025 and garnered the Department of Labor “Hire Vets” Platinum Medallion Award from 2021 to 2025.

Position Overview:
This position supports the a Marine Corps Program Office
as a Senior AI Data Analyst
. This effort provides dedicated Modeling, Simulation, and Analysis (MS&A) expertise to the Headquarters Marine Corps Installations & Logistics (HQMC I&L) Global Positioning Network Program Office (GPN PO). The Senior AI Data Analyst serves as the lead analyst and on-site coordinator at the Pentagon, directing an off-site data team and delivering analytics, modeling, and simulation products that inform prepositioning and global logistics decisions. This is a Key Personnel position.

This Position is Contingent Upon Award

Benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision (82% of employee’s premium paid by company, 25% towards dependents)
HSA / FSA Medical Plans
PTO
Flexible Work Environment and Encourage Work/Life Balance
401K with Company Match
Observes all federal holidays
Professional Development/Tuition Reimbursement Program
Annual Career Development Process

Job Type:
Full-time/Exempt

Location:
On-Site: The Pentagon, Arlington, VA (Government business hours 0700–1700 EST, Monday through Friday)

Anticipated Start Date:
Upon Contract Award (Anticipated: September 30, 2026)

Position Responsibilities

Serve as the primary on-site analytical advisor for Analytics, Modeling, and Simulation efforts at the Pentagon; facilitate technical discussions with Government stakeholders and external entities.
Lead and direct the off-site junior/mid-level data team, setting priorities, reviewing products, and ensuring analytical quality and timeliness.
Implement data standards and deploy automation tools to extract, synthesize, and validate data from disparate sources and transform data into usable metrics.
Construct data sets, monitor data quality, and troubleshoot and resolve database issues to ensure data integrity for model input.
Develop algorithms, user interfaces, and visualizations using languages such as Python and R to communicate analytical results to senior decision-makers.
Apply AI/ML frameworks to develop predictive models, recommend optimal solutions, and analyze complex logistics datasets.
Build, run, and refine high-resolution models and simulations supporting prepositioning planning and global logistics analysis.

Requirements

Position Requirements:

Bachelor's Degree.
Eight or more years of related experience.
Expertise in developing algorithms, creating user interfaces, synthesizing data, and producing visualizations using languages like Python or R.
Proven experience applying AI/ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) to develop predictive models, recommend optimal solutions, and analyze complex datasets.
Experience using high-resolution, complex modeling and simulation software (e.g., ExtendSim) and simulation-optimization tools (e.g., OptDef).
Familiarity with how data is captured and used from DoW logistics systems (e.g., TFSMS, GCSS-MC, MCPIC) and the ability to manipulate these sources for model input.
Active Secret security clearance (must be maintained for the duration of the contract).
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a DoW Common Access Card (CAC).

Preferred Skills/Experience

Master's Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
Experience supporting Marine Corps or Joint logistics organizations, prepositioning programs, or the PPBE process.
Experience leading distributed analytical teams in a client-facing environment.
Experience with cloud analytics platforms (e.g., Databricks, War Data Platform) and DoW data environments.

Pay Range
United States of America: $125,000 - $150,000 USD.

Base pay offered may vary depending on geography, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. A full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position, is offered. KSA Integration is an equal opportunity employer.
